text:
[LTIM.2.1.2] The runtime must drive `now()` from the engine's
wall clock ([LTIM.2.8.3]), never from a platform clock read directly. Both
engine clocks are mockable via test harness controls: `clock_set` and
`clock_advance` move the monotonic clock, `clock_advance` moves the wall clock
by the same interval, and `wall_clock_set` sets the wall clock alone
([LTES.3.2.2]).

idris.name: ltim_2_1_1__now_tracks_the_clock_timed
idris.note: 'The runtime must drive `now()` from the engine's wall clock', which `clock_advance` moves: the gate opens when the advance moves the wall past the instant. Executed.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_3__wall_set_timed
idris.note: '`clock_advance` moves the wall clock by the same interval, and `wall_clock_set` sets the wall clock alone': the one step both reach, after the tick for an advance and by itself for a set. LESS than the clause: the harness controls by their effect on the sample, not by name.

idris.name: ntst_3_1__advance
idris.note: '`clock_advance` moves the wall clock by the same interval': the two steps of one advance. A fixture.
